defs.def: physically or mentally ill （身体或精神）生病的，有病的

ex.s: Many would become sick, due to the extreme cold and low air pressure, and a few would even lose their lives.
ex.t: 许多人会因为极端寒冷和低气压而生病，少数人甚至会丧命。

ex.s: There was water everywhere, but we couldn’t drink any of it otherwise we’d get really sick.
ex.t: 到处都是水，但我们一滴也不能喝，否则会病得很重。

ex.s: Bonds, who bought his first cattle almost 50 years ago, still has each of his cowboys inspect 300 or 400 cattle daily and look for signs that an animal is getting sick.
ex.t: 邦德在近50年前购买了他的第一头牛，他仍然让每个牛仔每天检查300或400头牛，并寻找动物生病的迹象。

ex.s: A computer system will analyze the video to determine whether a cow is sick.
ex.t: 一个计算机系统将分析视频，判断一头牛是否生病。

ex.s: There was a man sick in bed, his wife, who took care of him and could not go out to work, and their little boy.
ex.t: 有一位生病卧床的男人，他的妻子照顾他、无法外出工作，还有他们的小男孩。

ex.t: 有一位生病卧床的男人，他的妻子照顾他、无法外出工作，还有他们的小男孩。

Trying to help injured, displaced or sick creatures can be heartbreaking; survival is never certain.
ex.t: 试图帮助受伤、流离失所或生病的动物可能令人心碎；生存永远无法保证。

ex.s: And why is the water so dirty that it makes them sick?” Young Ryan thought, “Life is easy for me, but hard for those people.
ex.t: “为什么水这么脏，让他们生病？”小Ryan想，“对我来说生活是轻松的，但对他们来说却很艰难。”

ex.s: Similarly, when people go for a few days without sleeping, they get sick.
ex.t: 同样，人如果好几天不睡觉，就会生病。

defs.def: feeling that you want to vomit 想呕吐；恶心

ex.s: His father said that the cat must be sick.
ex.t: 他的爸爸说这只猫肯定是病了。

defs.def: feeling sick as a result of travelling on a ship, plane, etc. 构成复合词

ex.s: I had bacon and eggs for breakfast, and now I'm feeling a bit sick - I hope I can make it to Bank station...
ex.t: 我早餐吃了熏肉和鸡蛋，现在觉得有点不舒服——希望我能撑到银行站……

ex.s: But it was now getting real dark． If I kept going I might not be able to see my way back． My mum would be worried sick if I didn't come home soon． So I ran back home almost in the dark while trying not to get too scared．
ex.t: 但天这会儿真的黑了。如果我继续走，可能看不清回去的路。如果我不快点回家，妈妈会担心死的。所以我几乎是摸黑跑回家，努力不让自己太害怕。

defs.def: bored with or annoyed about sth that has been happening for a long time, and wanting it to stop （对 … ）厌倦的，厌烦的，厌恶的

ex.s: But Moore was sick of missing out on candies.
ex.t: 一切始于摩尔和她爸爸一起去银行的时候。

defs.def: dealing with suffering, disease or death in a cruel way that some people think is offensive 尤指幽默
getting enjoyment from doing strange or cruel things 变态的；病态的
feeling very angry or worried 非常生气；非常着急
feeling that you want to vomit 想呕吐；恶心
food that you bring back up from your stomach through your mouth 呕吐物
people who are ill/sick 病人

ex.s: To do CPR, you press on the sick person’s chest so that blood moves through the body and takes oxygen to organs.
ex.t: 做心肺复苏时，你按压病人的胸部，让血液流经全身，把氧气输送到各个器官。

ex.s: Our study showed that there was a 30% decrease in sick leave for people who were in plant-rich workplaces.”
ex.t: 我们的研究表明，在植物丰富的工作场所工作的人的病假减少了30 ％。”

ex.s: He wrote books so that they could learn about how he treated the sick.
ex.t: 他写书是为了让他们了解他是如何对待病人的。

ex.s: The Saint Lukas train doesn’t accept passengers — it accepts only the sick.
ex.t: 圣卢卡斯号列车不接纳乘客——它只接纳病人。

ex.s: One was that I was amazing at the fact that a sick person could feel much more better after seeing a doctor.
ex.t: 其中一点是，令我惊讶的是，一个病人看完医生后竟能感觉好得多这一事实。
